list: The official 55 trophies, as published on PlayStation and listed by Exophase (exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies) and cross-checked against PSNProfiles. Names, descriptions, grades and hidden flags are the official ones; the guides, kinds and roadmap stages are this guide's own grouping, written for this entry.
notes: All 55 trophies are single-player and offline; there are no online or difficulty trophies. 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden. Only one trophy is reported as potentially missable (Positive Mental Attitude, #28): keep a manual save at the start of each chapter, since there is no mission replay. Guides marked 'unconfirmed' describe trophies whose official description is cryptic and whose exact in-game trigger was not yet confirmed by a cited guide at launch — the app says so rather than inventing a step.
sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official names, descriptions, grades, hidden flags)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (cross-check of names, descriptions and grades)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap (missable flag, ~200-hour estimate, no online trophies)
GTABase — GTA 6 trophy list (Gamerscore values, missable flag)

trophies.guide: The Platinum. It unlocks automatically once you hold the other 54 trophies, so there is nothing to do for this one directly — work through the roadmap below and it pops last. Source: official description (Exophase); roadmap method per PowerPyx.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to the end — it is the first mission of the game, so this is one of the first trophies you will earn. Source: official description (Exophase).
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish every mission in Chapter 1; the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Before you leave Chapter 1, meditate at Lucia's balcony spot (see #28) — it is the one spot that can disappear later. Sources: official description (Exophase); missable warning per PowerPyx and GTABase.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish every mission in Chapter 2; the trophy pops at the chapter's end. Chapter 2 is where both protagonists become playable, which opens most of the open-world trophies — start side activities from here. Source: official description (Exophase).
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish every mission in Chapter 3; the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter in case you want to replay any of it later — there is no mission replay. Sources: official description (Exophase); no-replay note per PowerPyx.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish every mission in Chapter 4; the trophy pops at the chapter's end. After Chapter 4 you are one step from the finale — save manually before the final mission so you can mop up anything left. Source: official description (Exophase).
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable, and one of only two Golds. Finish the final mission and this pops. Do your open-world cleanup either before the finale or after it in free roam — the mission itself cannot be missed. Source: official description (Exophase).
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the story; it pops on completion. If a story mission is not showing, advance the story until the contact calls. Source: official description (Exophase).
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission The Cartel Heist when the story offers it. Heist missions are story-gated, so just keep playing the story in order. Source: official description (Exophase).
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission Child's Play when it appears in the story; it pops on completion. Source: official description (Exophase).
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission Headliners when the story offers it; it pops on completion. Source: official description (Exophase).
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission VCIA Takedown when it appears in the story; it pops on completion. Source: official description (Exophase).
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory when the story offers it; it pops on completion. Source: official description (Exophase).
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The second Gold and the hardest trophy on the list. Reach 100% completion: the in-game checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion) appears after the story, but progress you made earlier already counts, and nothing on it is missable. Work through the other 53 trophies first — most of the checklist is the same work — then use the checklist to find the last few percent. Sources: official description (Exophase); checklist behaviour per GTABase; hardest-trophy rating per PowerPyx.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Grind trophy — 250 stunts in total, tracked by the game. A stunt is any jump, near-miss, wheelie, stoppie or airtime trick while driving or riding; chain them on long highway runs and beach straights rather than hunting one spot. The counter is cumulative across the whole playthrough, so it builds up while you do everything else. Source: official description and count (Exophase).
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sampler trophy. Play each of the 9 activity types once — the game counts a type when you start and finish one of its events (races, fishing, shooting range, drone races, arcade, bowling, darts-style bar games, meditation and the other open-world activities the in-game activity menu lists). Open the activities menu and tick them off one by one; none needs a win. Source: official description (Exophase); activity count of 9 as listed in the starter's verified list.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Skill trophy — gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit the Ammu-Nation shooting ranges, learn each weapon's recoil pattern, and take your time: gold needs accuracy, not speed, so fire in short bursts and reset a challenge rather than finishing it badly. The 42 count is what PlayStation tracks for this trophy. Source: official description and count (Exophase).
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location has its own race; you only need one win per location, not every race at each one. Learn the gates on a practice run, then race clean — cutting a gate costs more time than the shortcut saves. Source: official description and location count (Exophase).
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across Leonida — street, off-road, boat and air races all count, but each race only counts once, so you need 20 distinct events. Use the fastest vehicle you own for each race type and re-run a race you lost rather than grinding one you already won. Source: official description (Exophase).
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Challenge Cal to a fishing challenge and beat his catch. Fish where the challenge marker points, watch the line tension, and reel steadily — snapping the line loses the fish and the challenge. Cal's challenges unlock through the fishing activity, so play a few casual fishing sessions first. Source: official description (Exophase).
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish one full arcade game at an arcade cabinet — any game, any cabinet. You do not need a high score or a win against anyone; completing a run is enough. Arcades are marked on the map once you have visited one. Source: official description (Exophase).
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Side-mission trophy, unmissable once the strand is available. Play through Andy's mission strand to its final mission and finish it. Contact strands unlock as the story advances — if Andy has no mission for you yet, keep playing the story. Source: official description (Exophase).
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Side-mission trophy, unmissable once the strand is available. Play through Kenton's mission strand to its final mission and finish it. Source: official description (Exophase).
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Side-mission trophy, unmissable once the strand is available. Play through Billy's mission strand to its final mission and finish it. Source: official description (Exophase).
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands in full. Strangers appear as question-mark contacts around Leonida — start each strand, play it to its end, and move to the next. The count is strands completed, not missions, so a strand with five missions still counts as one. Source: official description and count (Exophase).
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Side-mission trophy, unmissable once the strand is available. Play through Randy's mission strand to its final mission and finish it. Source: official description (Exophase).
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Side-mission trophy, unmissable once the strand is available. Play through Tyrone's mission strand to its final mission and finish it. Source: official description (Exophase).
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE missable one — the only trophy PowerPyx and GTABase flag as potentially missable. Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. One spot, Lucia's balcony, is only available in Chapter 1, so meditate there before Chapter 1 ends; the other 17 can be done any time. Because there is no mission replay, keep a manual save at the start of every chapter until this pops. Sources: official description and spot count (Exophase); missable flag per PowerPyx and GTABase.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Side-mission trophy. Take Bret's hunting job, track the unique animal he names, and bring it down. Use the hunting prompts the game gives you — the animal is a one-off, so a failed hunt means finding it again, not failing the trophy. Source: official description (Exophase).
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Collectible trophy. Complete 3 full collectible card sets — cards are hidden around Leonida, and a set is complete when you hold every card in it. Sweep one neighbourhood at a time and use the in-game collection screen to see which cards each set is missing before you move on. Source: official description and count (Exophase).
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Collectible trophy — use the WAiNK phone feature at 100 different locations. Each location counts once, so keep moving: photograph or check in at a new spot each time instead of repeating one. The in-game counter shows your progress. Source: official description and count (Exophase).
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 challenges from the game's challenge list — daily-style feats, driving feats, combat feats and exploration feats all count, and the counter is cumulative. Pick the easy ones first (short drives, simple stunts) and let the rest fill in while you play. Source: official description and count (Exophase).
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Partner trophy. With your partner beside you, raise a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Do it in the countryside where you can break line of sight, keep both of you in the same vehicle, and do not let your partner get busted or killed mid-escape. Source: official description (Exophase).
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Partner trophy. With your partner, rob 3 shops one after another without ever losing your wanted level between them — the chain breaks if the heat drops to zero, so drive straight from shop to shop. Plan a route through three close shops, keep the car ready outside, and do not stop to fight the police. Source: official description (Exophase).
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — drive or ride each one and it counts as discovered. Variety is what matters: try every class (cars, bikes, boats, planes, trucks) and steal what you see parked rather than re-driving your favourite. The vehicle list in-game shows what you have found. Source: official description and count (Exophase).
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat trophy. Activate Combat Focus (slow-mo targeting) and take down 5 enemies before it ends. Set it up: lure a group into one place, or use it during a shootout with plenty of enemies, and aim for quick headshots so all five fall inside one activation. Source: official description (Exophase).
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Hidden trophy with a cryptic description — unconfirmed exact trigger at launch. The description points at Vice City International Airport: get airside and leave by an aircraft that is not a scheduled flight, i.e. steal a plane and take off from VCIA. Treat this as a best reading of the official text, not a confirmed step, and check the in-game hint once you are at the airport. Source: official description (Exophase); trigger unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Hidden trophy with a cryptic description — unconfirmed exact trigger at launch. The description names the Rhino tank: get into a Rhino and use it in combat, most plausibly surviving or causing mayhem in one. The trophy's name and text are the only confirmed facts; do not take any single fan theory as the method. Source: official description (Exophase); trigger unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Heist trophy. Rob a jewelry store and get out without any detection — no alarm, no witness calling the police, no camera spotting you. Go in quiet, move when the clerk looks away, take the goods and leave before anyone reacts; if the alarm trips, leave and try again. Source: official description (Exophase).
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Heist trophy. Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Each vault needs its own job — plan the getaway car before you go in, and escape cleanly rather than fighting the response. The counter is cumulative, so you can do them one at a time between other trophies. Source: official description and count (Exophase).
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Heist trophy. Find an armored truck on the road, rob it, and escape the police response. Ram it to a stop or block it, grab the cash, and break line of sight fast — trucks spawn on highways and near banks. Source: official description (Exophase).
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Exploration trophy. Visit every named region of Leonida — Vice City, the beaches, the swamps, the Keys, the countryside and the small towns. Drive the map edge to edge; the in-game map fills in as you go, and the trophy pops when the last region registers. Source: official description (Exophase).
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Heist trophy. Rob one illegal operation for every gang in Leonida. Each gang's operation is a different location and crew, so work through them gang by gang and use the in-game tracker to see which gangs you have hit. Source: official description (Exophase).
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Hidden trophy, and a gentle one. Go to Ocean Beach, find a bar or vendor with a view of the water, and enjoy a cocktail there. No combat, no timer — it pops when the scene registers. Source: official description (Exophase).
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Hidden trophy with a cryptic description — unconfirmed exact trigger at launch. The text points at a vehicle showroom: drive a car through the showroom glass and out the other side, the classic GTA-style exit. Treat this as a best reading of the official text, not a confirmed step. Source: official description (Exophase); trigger unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Hidden trophy. Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a full game — follow through on the throw the description hints at. Bowling is one of the activity types, so this also counts toward trying each activity once (#16). Source: official description (Exophase).
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Hidden trophy with a cryptic description — unconfirmed exact trigger at launch. The text suggests a partnership moment that wins over a crowd, most plausibly a public stunt or performance done together with your partner. The name and text are the only confirmed facts; treat any specific method as unconfirmed until a cited guide confirms it. Source: official description (Exophase); trigger unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Hidden trophy with a cryptic description — unconfirmed exact trigger at launch. The text points at a story choice with consequences: make a major decision at a branching point in the story and see it through. Which choice counts is not confirmed by a cited guide yet, so do not reload or replay a choice for this one until it is. Source: official description (Exophase); trigger unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Hidden trophy with a cryptic description — unconfirmed exact trigger at launch. The text suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt — most plausibly retrying a failed activity or mission and completing it. Which retry counts is not confirmed by a cited guide yet. Source: official description (Exophase); trigger unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Hidden trophy with a cryptic description — unconfirmed exact trigger at launch. The text reads like a reaction to something strange in the world, most plausibly a random event or easter egg. Wander Leonida's odd corners and the trophy will come to you; no specific method is confirmed by a cited guide yet. Source: official description (Exophase); trigger unconfirmed.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Hidden trophy. Perform a melee drive-by that bowls over a target — attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon and knock the target down. Practice at low speed in a quiet street until the hit registers, then drive off before the police respond. Source: official description (Exophase).
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Money trophy. Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts — the counter is cumulative, so keep laundering every bill you earn from heists and robberies instead of spending them directly. Contacts take a cut, so the gross you move is what counts. Source: official description and amount (Exophase).
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Money trophy. Spend $100,000 in total across all shops — clothes, weapons, food, vehicles and property upgrades all count, and the counter is cumulative across the whole playthrough. It fills naturally while you gear up; if you are short at the end, buy and sell high-value items. Source: official description and amount (Exophase).
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Money trophy. Buy every garage property in Leonida. Save up through the story and heists, check the property listings as new ones unlock, and buy them as you can afford them — the trophy pops on the last purchase. Source: official description (Exophase).
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app on your phone, register a vehicle you own or have just found, and repeat until you reach 10 — each vehicle counts once. Source: official description and count (Exophase).
trophies.name: On the Spot
